scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a housing loan and I wanted to check the status of my application. Can you tell me if it has been approved or denied? Also, what is the interest rate on the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved. The interest rate on the loan is 6.99%.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know. What are the total costs associated with this loan? Also, I noticed that my loan purpose was listed as "Other purpose." Could you clarify what that means?
dialogue.agent: The total loan costs are not present in the record. The loan purpose of "Other purpose" typically means it does not fit into standard categories like home purchase or refinance.

dialogue.user: I see. Could you tell me if there are any high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan? Also, has my loan been sold to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage, and it does not have negative amortization features. The loan has not been sold to another institution.

dialogue.user: Great, thank you for that information. One last question: What type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: You were approved for a conventional subordinate lien loan.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for all the information. I appreciate your help.

<Neutral> The agent provided all the information I needed, but I was hoping to get more details on the total loan costs, which weren't available in the record.
